Roofers in Heath Hayes

In short

Heath Hayes is two miles from our yard. A lot of what we do here is roofline and re-roofing on the post-war estates, plus bungalow work where the access is straightforward.

Roofing in Heath Hayes

Heath Hayes is another of the villages that grew on mining and then spread into a suburb of Cannock. Almost nothing here predates the twentieth century: it is interwar semis, post-war estates and a notably high proportion of bungalows, running out towards Wimblebury and Five Ways. That means concrete interlocking tile more or less throughout, much of it original and now due. The bungalows change the economics of a job in a useful way, because a single storey roofline can often be reached with a tower rather than a full scaffold, which keeps fascia, soffit and guttering work considerably cheaper here than on the two storey stock a mile up the road in Hednesford.

What we do in Heath Hayes

Roof repairsMost roofs do not fail all at once. They fail at one detail, and the damage spreads from there. Roof replacementA re-roof is the one job where everything that matters is hidden by the time you see it finished. Fascias, soffits and gutteringGuttering is the cheapest part of a roof and the one that does the most damage when it is ignored. Roof cleaningMoss is not just untidy. It holds water against the tile and pushes it into the laps. Flat roofingA flat roof is not actually flat, and most of the ones that fail were treated as though it were. Conservatory warm roofsThe room you stopped using in January and could not sit in during July. Chimneys and leadworkMost roofs that leak are not leaking through the tiles. They are leaking where the roof meets something else.

Frequently asked questions

Do I need scaffolding on a bungalow?

Often not. A lot of Heath Hayes roofline work can be done safely off a tower, which takes a real chunk out of the price. We will tell you which when we look.

Can you match the tiles on my estate?

Usually. We run our own roofing supplies shop, and the concrete tile profiles used across these estates are ones we deal with constantly.

Do you charge for a quote?

No. Someone comes out, looks at the roof properly and gives you a fixed written price. There is no charge and no obligation.

How far do you travel?

We work to roughly a twenty mile radius of our yard in Hednesford, which covers Cannock Chase, most of south Staffordshire and the north of the Black Country. If you are just outside that it is still worth ringing.

Are you insured?

Yes. Midland Roof Shield carries public liability insurance and we are happy to show you the certificate before any work starts.
